news.api_views module

REST API views for the News application.

Clients authenticate with a token from api_token() and can then list, create, update, delete and approve articles, and list newsletters.

news.api_views.api_article_approve(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Approve an article (editors only).

news.api_views.api_article_detail(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

GET – Retrieve a single article. PUT – Update an article (editors/journalists). DELETE – Delete an article (editors/journalists).

news.api_views.api_article_list(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

GET – Return all approved articles. POST – Create a new article (journalists only).

news.api_views.api_article_subscribed(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Return only articles from the reader’s subscribed publishers/journalists.

news.api_views.api_newsletter_list(request, *args, **kwargs)[source]

Return all newsletters with their authors and articles.

Parameters:

request (rest_framework.request.Request) – The authenticated API request

Returns:

A JSON list of serialized newsletters

Return type:

rest_framework.response.Response

news.models module

Database models for the News application.

Defines publishers, users with reader/journalist/editor roles, articles and newsletters.

class news.models.Article(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: Model

A news article written by a journalist.

Articles are hidden from readers until an editor approves them.

Parameters:

  • title (str) – Headline of the article

  • content (str) – Body text of the article

  • author (CustomUser) – Journalist who wrote the article

  • approved (bool) – Whether an editor has approved the article, defaults to False

  • publisher (Publisher, optional) – Publisher the article belongs to, or None if the journalist published it independently

news.urls module

news.views module

HTML views for the News application.

Handles registration and login, the article workflow (create, edit, approve, delete), reader subscriptions, publishers and newsletters. Access is restricted by the user’s role: reader, journalist or editor.

news.views.article_approve(request, pk)[source]

Editors review and approve submitted articles.

news.views.article_create(request)[source]

Allow journalists to submit a new article for editorial approval.

news.views.article_delete(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists (own articles) and editors (any article) to delete an article.

news.views.article_detail(request, pk)[source]

Display a single article; unapproved articles are restricted to the author and editors.

news.views.article_edit(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists (own articles) and editors (any article) to edit an article.

news.views.article_list(request)[source]

Display all approved articles to authenticated users.

news.views.article_pending(request)[source]

Display the approval queue to editors, with options to edit, approve, or reject articles.

news.views.login_view(request)[source]

Display the login form and authenticate the user.

news.views.logout_view(request)[source]

Log the current user out and redirect to the login page.

news.views.my_articles(request)[source]

Show a journalist all of their articles (approved and pending) with management options.

news.views.newsletter_create(request)[source]

Allow journalists and editors to create a new newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_delete(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists (own newsletters) and editors (any newsletter) to delete a newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_detail(request, pk)[source]

Display a single newsletter and its linked articles.

news.views.newsletter_edit(request, pk)[source]

Allow journalists (own newsletters) and editors (any newsletter) to edit a newsletter.

news.views.newsletter_list(request)[source]

Display all newsletters to authenticated users.

news.views.publisher_create(request)[source]

Allow editors to create a new publisher.

news.views.register_view(request)[source]

Display the registration form and create a new user account.

news.views.subscriptions(request)[source]

Display all journalists and publishers; allow readers to subscribe or unsubscribe.

news.views.toggle_journalist_subscription(request, pk)[source]
